input.brief: Connect-Air, climatização de comércio e indústria em São Paulo há 15 anos: instalação, manutenção preventiva e corretiva, contratos mensais e PMOC para VRF, chiller, fancoil e splitão

direction.name: The dark room
direction.idea: One dark field from top to bottom, and in it, lit things. Photographs and objects appear like exhibits in a dim gallery: each with space around it, each the brightest thing on its screen. Type is light, small and sparse. The darkness is not a theme switch; it is a room, and the page is a slow walk through it. It suits subjects sold on atmosphere and material: an evening restaurant, a metal card, a record, a house at dusk.
direction.composition: A single near-black or deep-toned ground runs the full page with no section bands. First screen: either the name at full width in a light weight along the bottom edge with one dim photograph above it, or one object or photograph centred at 40–50% of the viewport with a line of text beneath at 16–18px. Each later screen holds one or two lit items at a generous size (the main one 40–60% of the screen width) with its text set beside it at full reading size; the darkness frames the items, it does not replace content. Images vary in size but all share the same darkness at their edges so they sit in the ground without frames. Practical details come last in a simple two-column text block. The only solid light element on the page is the single primary action.
direction.typography: Light or regular weights; they glow on dark. Avoid heavy bold, which looks cheap on black. Headings 4–7vw at most; text 16–18px with leading 1.6 and a slightly lifted ink (not pure white).
direction.colour: A dark ground with a tint (blue-black, green-black, brown-black), a soft light ink, a dimmer ink for secondary text, and one warm or bright accent used once per screen at most.
direction.imagery: Low-key photographs: dark backgrounds, one light source, subjects emerging from shadow. Their dark edges should blend into the page ground.
direction.photoTreatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.
direction.richness: Light against dark, and the slow pacing.
direction.pitfalls: Grey text on black fails contrast quickly: check it. No glow effects, no neon accent, no coloured light blobs. A dark page with a bright busy photograph is not this direction; choose low-key images. Dark does not mean empty: every screen still carries its content at a readable size, and running text is a light ink at 7:1 or more, not a dim grey.

hero.name: Two doors on a dark wall
hero.blueprint: For a subject with two halves a visitor must choose between: two exhibitions, two audiences, two places, two collections. One near-black flat field. Two portrait photographs at 3:4, each 280×373px, stand side by side 80px apart, so the pair spans x 400–1040 (44% of the width) with their tops at 300px; square corners, no frame, the pictures supplying every colour on the screen. Each photograph is the link to its half, and directly beneath it, left-aligned to the frame, sit its name at 22px in the light ink and one line at 16px in the soft ink. The headline is centred above the pair: two lines at clamp(36px, 3.4vw, 52px), leading 1.05, its first line 104px from the top, at most 26 characters per line. Wordmark top-left and one text link top-right at 15px on 32px margins. About 150px of dark ground stays below the pair and 400px either side of it, closed by the two doors at the centre. Pointing at or focusing one door keeps it at full strength and dims the other to 50%. The page continues below with the two halves in order, so each door is also an anchor to its half.
hero.mobile: The pair stays side by side: each photograph 168px wide at 3:4 with a 14px gap, centred at 46% of the height, its name at 17px and its line at 16px beneath it. The headline sits above at 8vw on two lines, centred, 64px down. The wordmark and the link stay in the top corners.
hero.headline: A 4–8 word sentence on two lines that names the choice, at most 26 characters per line.

type.note: A slightly narrow neo-grotesk with closed apertures, used at regular weight from marquee size down to paragraphs. Suits agencies and digital studios that want large type without heaviness.

photos.title: Architecture
photos.note: structure, lines, bridges, facades and building interiors
photos.treatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.

motion.name: Stillness
motion.description: No showpiece. The page is simply there, instantly, and the discipline is the statement. Motion is limited to exact feedback: a 140ms press on the button, a 180ms colour change on links, focus rings that appear without delay. Do not add a load animation or scroll reveals to this direction.

sections.name: One-size name columns
sections.blueprint: Pure text at one size. Three columns start on columns 1, 4 and 7 of the 12-column grid, leaving columns 10–12 empty on purpose. Each column opens with a group name in full ink and continues with a tight stack of six to ten capability names in the soft ink, all at 16–17px, regular weight, line-height 1.25, no bullets and no symbols; one blank line separates group name from stack. Hovering a name brings it to full ink and shows a one-line description in a fixed spot: the top of the empty columns 10–12, at the same size. The heading is no larger than 28px; two or three words, alone on column 1, 96px above the columns. Give the section 20vh of empty ground above and below, so the smallness reads as decided. Works on light or deep grounds.
sections.mobile: Columns stack with 40px between groups; text rises to 18px with line-height 1.4 for touch. Group names stay in full ink. Hover descriptions are dropped; each group ends instead with one sentence in the soft ink that sums it up. The heading is 24px, 48px above.

sections.name: Sticky photograph, active list
sections.blueprint: Two columns. The left, columns 1–5, is `position: sticky; top: 12vh` and holds one photograph or object at 4:5, 34vw wide, unframed on the ground. The right, columns 7–11, holds a vertical list of five to nine names (treatments, rooms, courses, services) at clamp(20px, 1.6vw, 24px), each row 58px tall with the name at the left and a price or duration right-aligned at 15px in the soft ink. The active row is full ink; the others rest at 40% opacity. Hovering, focusing or scrolling a row to the middle of the viewport makes it active, crossfades the left photograph to that item's image over 300ms, and opens a three-line description at 15px, 34ch wide, directly under the name, pushing later rows down. A heading of two or three words at clamp(32px, 3.4vw, 48px) sits above the list, aligned to its left edge, 48px above the first row.
sections.mobile: The photograph becomes a 4:3 band pinned to the top of the screen at 38svh while the list scrolls beneath it; the heading sits above the first row. Rows are 56px tall and the description opens on tap. The image changes with the row nearest the band.

sections.name: Staircase statement
sections.blueprint: On a flat dark or saturated field one sentence of 12–18 words is broken into five short lines at clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 64px), bold, leading 1.02, marked up as one paragraph (a statement, so it may run past two lines at this size). Each line starts further right than the one above: indents of 0, 6, 12, 18 and 24vw from a 4vw left margin, set with `padding-left` per line, so the block descends like stairs and ends near the 75% mark. Each line takes its own flat colour from the palette, or lines alternate between two inks. The block is vertically centred in a section 100svh tall. The right quarter (columns 10–12) holds two stacked photographs, each 3:2 and 20vw wide with a 16px gap, top-aligned with the first line. No heading; a two-line note at 15px sits at the bottom-left margin, on the first line's left edge. On a page without images, leave the right quarter empty.
sections.mobile: Five lines at 9vw (35px on a 390px screen) with indents of 0, 5, 10, 15 and 20vw, so the stair still reads on a 390px screen. The two photographs follow below as one row of two equal 3:2 frames. The note sits last, left-aligned.

sections.name: Inset panel, shaped portrait
sections.blueprint: A deep-toned panel inset 20px from the page edges with a 12px radius, about 110svh tall, `overflow: hidden`. Left half: a two-line statement of four to seven words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 64px) in a pale ink, top-left with 56px padding; it is the heading and has nothing above it. Below it a photograph of the person or the workshop, masked with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask` to one bold shape taken from the subject (a four-lobed flower, a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), 38vw across, positioned so the panel's bottom edge crops its lowest fifth. Right side, starting at 63% of the width and 56px from the top: two text blocks 300px wide and 64px apart, each a subhead at 22px over a four-line paragraph at 15px; then one solid button in the accent colour. Between the statement and the text blocks the panel is empty. One photograph only.
sections.mobile: The panel is inset 10px and stacks: the statement at 8.5vw, then the two text blocks at full width, the button, and last the shaped photograph at 86vw across, centred and cropped by the panel's bottom edge by a quarter of its height.

sections.name: Names as one sentence
sections.blueprint: Client, press or partner names are written out as one run-on sentence and set large: clamp(40px, 5vw, 76px), leading 1.0, flush left across all twelve columns, wrapping naturally over five to seven lines. Names are separated by commas and the list ends with a full stop. All names are set in a dimmed ink (still at least 3:1 against the ground), so the block reads as texture; one name at a time is lit in the full ink, and the lit name moves through the list every two seconds (a class toggled by a short script, with a 400ms colour transition). The sentence opens with two or three plain words in the full ink that act as the heading: the phrase that introduces the names. Nothing else is in the section: no logos, no columns, and 120px of space above and below.
sections.mobile: The same sentence at 9vw, wrapping over ten to fourteen lines; cut the list to the twelve strongest names so it stays within one and a half screens. The lit name still cycles. Margins are 20px and there are no other elements.

sections.name: Visit card on a photograph
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph of the place, 100vw by 100svh, carries one solid card and nothing else. The card is a filled panel in the paper colour, fully opaque, 380px wide with 8px corners and 32px padding, placed in the upper-right corner 60px from the top and right edges (or the upper-left: pick the corner where the photograph is calmest). It holds, top to bottom: a two- or three-word title at 28px in a light weight; the address on two lines at 16px; the opening hours as three rows with days at the left and times right-aligned in tabular figures; the phone number; then, flush with the card's bottom edge and spanning its width, a solid booking button 52px tall. The card may be `position: sticky; top: 60px` inside a taller section so it holds while the photograph scrolls beneath it. The photograph's focal point must stay clear of the card. No heading outside the card.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 70svh. The card leaves the corner: it spans the width with 16px margins and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 80px, so image and card interlock. The booking button is full width, 56px tall, at the card's bottom.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: Moto Finance
references.idea: A metal card presented like a museum piece: lit by a single overhead light box in a black room, then orbiting through dim architectural stills.
references.hero: Black full-bleed 3D scene. A pale silver-lavender light panel, a trapezoid in perspective like a ceiling light box, occupies the top 20% and centre 55% of the viewport. The two-line uppercase headline, centred at 4.4vw in medium grotesk with tight leading, straddles the panel's lower edge so its first line sits half on light, half on black. In the exact centre a small metal card stands on a low plinth, only about 150px wide, surrounded by darkness. A light-grey pill button (about 250 by 52px) is centred near the bottom; the logo is top-left and a dark pill button top-right.
references.type: Neue Montreal only: weight 500 uppercase at 64px (4.4vw) with near-zero tracking and leading under 1.0 for headings, 20px sentence case for body, tiny caps labels in the footer. Three sizes; centred until the left-aligned footer.
references.colour: #080808 #edefef #c4cbd6 #e1e5e5 #2a2f3a — Black with cool silver-grey and no brand colour at all. One section inverts to pale grey-white with grey type; the only chroma is amber city lights and a blue atmosphere rim on the globe.
references.imagery: Rendered chrome card with an embossed profile medallion, a night-side Earth, and small dim architectural and fashion stills floating as tilted panels in 3D. Everything underexposed, cool and low-saturation.
references.layout: Full-viewport scenes stacked one per screen, each with a centred uppercase heading, an optional short sub-line and a pill button. One light interlude breaks the black. The footer switches to a left-aligned statement with link columns at the far right.

sections.description: Centred heading at the top with a two-line grey sub-line and a pale pill button directly under it. The lower 45% is the top arc of a night-side Earth rising from the bottom edge, about 75% of the viewport wide, with city lights and a bright blue-white rim on the upper right. Three small dark capsule labels with check icons float over and beside the globe at staggered positions, like status notifications.

A dark 3D room: about twelve small photo panels (roughly 70 by 90px, each tilted at its own angle, heavily dimmed) arranged in two loose rows across the full width, receding with blur. The card stands edge-on in the centre, much larger, catching a specular highlight. Later the card faces front at top-centre and a centred two-line heading with a pill button sits under it.

A pale grey-white band. Two tall columns of currency amounts in mid-size light-grey sans, one at a quarter and one at three-quarters of the width, each fading to white at top and bottom like slot-machine reels, with the centre rows darkest. Between them, three short centred lines of small black text. The bottom edge of the band reveals a dark photograph.

steal: Let a headline straddle the edge of a light shape so one line is half on light and half on dark.
Show the product very small in a large dark space in the first viewport, then let it grow as the page scrolls.
Use vertically scrolling columns of real-looking figures, faded at both ends, as a quiet backdrop for a three-line statement.
references.media: An 11s hero video of a CG metal card on a plinth covers the whole first screen and holds on its last frame. Then a pinned WebGL globe in the lower half under centred text, a 3D card centred in a depth cloud of small photo tiles dimmed to 30-40%, full-bleed sticky photographs with text docked in opposite corners, and a photo strip sitting on an index list; all low-key and desaturated, photos meeting the near-black ground through 200-300px fades, 0px radius.
references.motion: The intro ends in about 1.2s as the camera pushes in and the headline, nav and button arrive (load 9.9s), and Lenis then runs 32 ScrollTriggers: the globe pins for 2.5 viewports at scrub 1, the card turns in 3D across its section, the theme inverts to pale grey with the nav colour following, and benefit rows scrub in one by one. Lines rise by yPercent over 0.65s power3.out and leave over 0.45s power2.in, and headings rise from a blur over 1s power2.inOut.

references.name: IZANAMI
references.idea: Silence as design: one small sentence in fog, then a slow descent from mist into a dark glass pavilion.
references.hero: After a warm-black loader showing only one 18px serif sentence and a small counter, the hero is a full-bleed, desaturated grey-green image of pine forest dissolving into fog. The same sentence stays at 18px in white, left-aligned on a line about 17% from the left edge and exactly at vertical centre; it is the only text in the picture area. A small white seal-style logo sits top-left; a language switch and menu label in tiny tracked capitals sit top-right, each with a dot above. Along the bottom edge: copyright, two live city clocks, and a scroll cue at far right, all near 10px.
references.type: Playfair Display regular for the few headings, only 18 to 45px (3.1vw at most); Shippori Mincho for body at 14px; Cinzel capitals with wide tracking for nav, clocks and footer. Nothing is large: hierarchy comes from isolation rather than size.
references.colour: #0a0801 #6f7a70 #b7b5a6 #d9d2c3 #4b5b39 — Warm near-black panels and grey-green fog imagery with off-white text at reduced opacity. Moss green and sand from the small garden photos are the only colour; there is no accent.
references.imagery: Fog-bound forest, a black-framed glass pavilion seen in one-point perspective, and small crops of incense smoke, a bamboo water spout and raked gravel. Small images are square-cornered, portrait or square, overlapping one another and the dark ceiling plane.
references.layout: Wide margins, with text hung on an inner line about 17% across instead of the page edge. Most screens hold one image and one short text; small photos are placed asymmetrically near corners and overlap. A rotated section label runs down the left edge.

sections.description: Over the black ceiling of the pavilion image, a three-line serif heading at about 3vw sits left of centre, each line indented further than the one above. Faint body text follows below it. A small square photo sits top-left under the logo; at right, three portrait photos overlap in a cluster, two beige garden shots behind and a narrower green water-ripple image in front and raised higher, running off the bottom edge.

Full-bleed one-point-perspective view down a glass corridor, its ceiling filling the upper half as near-black. A text link with a short leading rule sits top-left on the inner line; a landscape photo of raked gravel is tucked against the top edge right of centre; a three-line heading fades in low and left of centre over the glass. A section name rotated ninety degrees runs down the far left.

Near-black and almost empty. One section name in serif at about 24px, preceded by a long thin rule, sits at mid-height left of centre. Lower down, tiny tracked-capital columns: a nav list, two office addresses side by side, and social links pushed to the far right. The bottom edge repeats the copyright and the two city clocks.

steal: Place a single 18px sentence at vertical centre on an offset left line over full-bleed fog, and let the absence of a headline be the statement.
Stair-step a three-line heading by indenting each line further than the one above it.
Run two live city clocks with time-zone labels along the bottom edge as quiet proof of where the firm operates.
references.media: A misted forest photograph covers the whole first screen under drifting cloud layers, with text on about 0.2% of the area. Then a pinned full-screen architectural scene dollies forward while overlapping collages of two or three photographs at different widths pass over it, rows pair a text column at about 28vw with a portrait flush to the right margin, and the fog band returns as a bookend; about 11 photographs, one WebGL canvas, no video.
references.motion: A warm near-black screen with the tagline already in place until about 2.5s, then a fog bank creeps in from the lower right and the chrome fades in by 4.5s; load took 7.2s. Lenis with three sticky sections scrubs the scene as the forest darkens and the camera sinks into the pavilion, photographs move at different rates, and headline lines fade in one by one; two cloud layers loop on 100s linear translates, and there is no reduced-motion rule.

references.name: LPAS
references.idea: An architecture and interiors practice organised by market sector: each of five sectors gets its own earthy ground colour, like swatches from a material board, and the sectors slide as a card rail over a fixed, dimmed video of the studio; a 45-degree corner cut taken from the logo is the one shape motif.
references.hero: After a charcoal loader of about 4.5s with four stacked process verbs, a full-bleed muted studio video at half brightness fills the screen. A thin wordmark top-left at 50px, a small dark menu pill top-right. The headline, 75px (5.2vw, leading 1.0) in three lines about 800px wide, is docked bottom-left with its last baseline about 65px above the bottom edge, and three 14px labels (discipline, approach, a scroll cue with a 30px circle arrow) sit exactly on the vertical centre line. A 200px sliver of the first sector card already shows at the right edge as the cue to continue. The headline arrives last, about 5s in.
references.type: Aeonik alone, almost entirely at 400 with 600 for small labels, sentence case throughout. A short scale: 75px display (5.2vw, leading 1.0), 56px for the credo and rail titles (3.9vw, leading 1.1), 50px for the closing list, 38 and 28px section titles, 16 and 14px body, 12px captions. Fluid sizes by clamp() on a 10px root.
references.colour: #ffffff #262626 #111111 #625653 #925434 #c9d3df #707569 #e3c1aa — White page, charcoal for the loader and footer, near-black text (though 65% of the characters are set in mid-grey #747474). Five sector grounds of similar value and low chroma (taupe, rust, pale blue-grey, sage, peach), each with a lighter tint for hover; no other accent.
references.imagery: Bright architectural photography with blue skies and dusk light, its brick and timber tones echoing the sector palette, and a 61s documentary-feeling studio video as the hero. Square corners, one 8:5 ratio for projects, no filters; the hero and the closing photo are dimmed to about 50% for white text, and pictures are oversized in their frames so they can drift.
references.layout: 50px margins and a 1340px measure on a 20-column main grid with 10px gutters. A fixed hero overtaken by a pinned horizontal rail (about 4320px of scroll), then a statement, a mirrored mosaic, a news list, a full-bleed photo band and a sticky footer uncovered like a curtain. Section gaps of about 100-140px. The ground changes by section: white, each sector colour, white, charcoal.

sections.description: Five sector cards, each about 770px wide (53.5vw), slide left over the dimmed hero: a photograph on the top 68% and a flat sector-colour panel on the bottom 32%, holding the sector name at 56px bottom-left with a 30px inset, a two-line 16px descriptor right-aligned and a 45px outline circle-plus button top-right. The incoming card's photo grows from about 450 to 615px tall as it centres; neighbours peek about 270px on the left and 400px on the right.
A three-line 56px credo about 647px wide at the top-left; below it a 14px label in a narrow left column and a 16px paragraph about 800px wide starting at x=388, closed by an underlined text link.

Six 8:5 images in two mirrored rows: one large (about 678x424, 47% of the width) beside two small ones (334x209), then two small ones bottom-aligned on the left under a placed void, with the large one on the right. The first large image has its top-left corner cut at 45 degrees by 60px and the last its bottom-right, so the cuts bracket the group. Each image carries a 16px name and a 12px place beneath it.

A full-bleed dimmed interior photograph carrying the five sector names stacked at 50px in white scrolls away to uncover a sticky 625px charcoal footer with two office addresses, social links and a back-to-top link.

steal: Give each content category its own flat ground drawn from one material family at similar value and low chroma, each with a lighter tint for hover, and keep the rest of the page white plus one charcoal, so the colours read as a system and not as decoration.

Take one shape from the logo and use it sparingly: a 45-degree corner cut of 20-60px on a single corner of selected images, alternating top-left on the first and bottom-right on the last so the cuts bracket a group.

Stagger a two-row mosaic big-small-small, then small-small-big, with the small pair bottom-aligned to the tall neighbour so the void above them is placed; keep one ratio and caption every image in 16px. The site's 75px hero headline runs to three lines; under the house rules cut it to two.
references.media: A 61s muted studio video at 50% brightness covers the whole first screen and stays fixed while a rail of photo-over-colour cards slides over it; projects sit in a mirrored 8:5 mosaic, and a full-bleed dimmed photo band carries the closing list. Thirteen media elements in all, no canvas or WebGL.
references.motion: Under Lenis the sector rail pins for about 4320px and travels about 836px per 900px of wheel while the incoming photo grows and pictures drift inside oversized frames. Project images wipe in with clip-path inset and opacity over 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.14,0.83,0.4,1), hovers take .3s cubic-bezier(0,0,.13,.99), the headline rises through a mask after the 4.5s loader, and there is no reduced-motion rule.
